{{Top}}
The '''TranLang II communications module''' was the predecessor to the highly popular [[TranLang III communications module/Legends|TranLang III communications module]]. The module featured around one million [[Language/Legends|languages]], and was installed in [[Protocol droid/Legends|protocol droids]] such as the [[J9 worker drone/Legends|J9 worker drone]],<ref name="EGTD">''[[The Essential Guide to Droids]]''</ref> and tutor [[Droid/Legends|droids]] such as the [[TTS-15 Series Tutorial Droid|TTS-15]].<ref name="Cynabar">''[[Cynabar's Fantastic Technology: Droids]]''</ref>
